title: The Scholarship of Lake Minnow
author: Xanthe Brightwater
blurb: Ada Okafor, the new kid at a school built over something old, has spent seven years being so careful it hurts. But when the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
